title: Construct lossless candidates from explicit record edits
description: Build complete candidate bytes from a bounded ordered set of targeted actor-supplied record decisions against one coherent before-state. Preserve all unselected meaning and bytes while generating only necessary representation bookkeeping; construction itself does not publish.
inputs: One coherent supported before-state and explicit target operation or bounded batch.
Actor-supplied mutable values, required new-record applicability, and preview or actual-execution intent.
outputs: Complete candidate bytes and explicit target effects, including necessary registration/bookkeeping.
A valid non-writing candidate preview or named missing-input, overlap, preservation, target, or shape rejection.
behavior: Use only closed purpose-specific operations and exact targets; fill metadata, deterministic paths, containers and registry entries mechanically without inventing semantic inputs.
Replace only selected value spans and necessary local syntax, preserve omitted fields/entries/narrative/formatting, and make no byte edit for semantically unchanged values.
Require declared applicability when creating a supporting record, preserve it when legitimately omitted on existing content, and distinguish missing registered content from absence.

Apply ordered operations to one candidate; allow final references to newly introduced objects, reject overlapping/duplicate assignments, and preserve the declared separations between assessment/findings and decision/shared narrative.

Retain complete Review findings, ID-only finding preservation and immutable blocker origin; preserve the distinction between full Verify replacement and narrow explanation updates, including optional-basis removal.
Validate the final candidate and expose candidate effects in preview without transaction files, reservations, or a saved claim; actual execution must rebuild under fresh checked state.

failure_behavior.condition: A decision/input is missing, a set target is absent, creation would overwrite unregistered content, or named edits overlap.
failure_behavior.outcome: Reject the candidate with the precise safe reason and no partial publication or synthesized actor decision.

failure_behavior.condition: The source representation cannot be preserved as required or final references/content are invalid.
failure_behavior.outcome: Reject rather than canonicalize unrelated existing bytes, publish an intermediate state, or make all actors supply unrelated simultaneous decisions.
